title: Historical Flight Data / Schedules Data
role: high-priority G2 global flight-level exposure candidate

documented_capabilities.historical_range: 2004-present for historical flight records; 20+ years for schedules
documented_capabilities.vintage_capability: OAG documentation states a historical-report parameter can look back in time to schedule data exactly as it was published. This is materially stronger for historical-vintage control than silently using a modern revised aggregate.
documented_capabilities.potential_exposure_unit: count of operated/actual flight legs or, if only schedules are licensed, count of scheduled flight legs with explicit cancellation/performance policy

scientific_fit.global_model_year_matrix: potentially feasible from flight-level aircraft/equipment records
scientific_fit.737_variant_resolution: potentially feasible only if equipment codes distinguish the required Original/Classic/NG/MAX cohorts consistently across vintages; must be demonstrated before use
scientific_fit.legacy_727_coverage: historical range is long enough in principle, but actual field/code coverage must be demonstrated
scientific_fit.cargo_and_passenger_scope: product documentation describes global airline flight records; precise commercial/cargo inclusion semantics require licensed field documentation and extraction audit
scientific_fit.actual_vs_scheduled: historical product advertises scheduled and actual flight records. G2 should prefer performed/actual departures; scheduled-only counts cannot silently substitute without a preregistered denominator definition.

access_and_reproducibility.redistribution_rights: unknown until license terms for the acquired product are reviewed
access_and_reproducibility.reproducibility_requirement: If acquired, freeze query/extraction specification, code mappings, coverage diagnostics, vintage mode, hashes/aggregate derivatives permitted by license, and enough provenance for independent audit without publishing restricted raw records.

gate_effect.reason: OAG is a technically promising global/vintage-aware source, but the project currently has no licensed dataset or demonstrated cohort-year extraction. Source capability is not evidence coverage.

next_validation: obtain lawful access or a sufficiently representative licensed sample/data dictionary
demonstrate equipment-code mapping for every BSFM Boeing cohort including 727 and 737 Original/Classic/NG/MAX
demonstrate global passenger/cargo commercial scope and performed-flight semantics for 2010-2025
quantify missing/unknown aircraft-type cells by year
freeze a historical-vintage policy before computing baseline probabilities
